introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2025. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all the tasks (Task I, Task II, Task III) specified in this question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains four versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two, Group Three and Group Four (booklets 00/0595/3/Grp 1, Grp 2, Grp 3 and Grp 4). Each version has three tasks: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task III (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks). A candidate works on one group only.

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (documents, workbooks and pictures supplied in the candidate folder) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.
enonce_intro_markdown:
**GROUP FOUR - TASK 1 (20 marks)**

The objective of this task is to test your ability to use word processor features to design a Flyer to advertise the services offered by an IT company named ITSHOP. Carefully follow the instructions given to design the sample form in Figure 1 below.

![fig-1](gce-ol-computer-science-2025-p3-officiel-cameroun_exercice_G4-T1_fig_1.png)

*Figure 1: Sample Flyer for advert. From top to bottom: the title ADVERT (underlined) in a framed page; a two-column table whose first row is the merged cell IT SHOP SERVICES, whose second row holds a picture of a laptop (left) and the words COMPUTER SUPPLY SERVICES in a decorative font (right); the sentence "We are currently on promotion, with discounts as indicated in the table below."; a table ITEM / SPECIFICATIONS / Unit Cost /FCFA / Discount with the rows Laptop Computers (700 000, 10%) and Desktop Computers (500 000, 15%); an oval with the contact information.*

Launch any word processor application installed on your computer and:

figures.legende: Figure 1 : exemple d'affiche (flyer) ADVERT de ITSHOP, redessinée d'après le scan : titre, tableau d'en-tête, tableau des prix et remises, ovale de contact

incertitudes: Le PDF (23 pages, scan avec une couche texte OCR bruitée, relu en image page par page) contient QUATRE versions du même sujet pratique : « Group One » (pages 1 à 6, livret 00/0595/3/Grp 1), « Group Two » (pages 7 à 11, Grp 2), « Group Three » (pages 12 à 17, Grp 3) et « Group Four » (pages 18 à 23, Grp 4). Page de garde vérifiée : GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD, ORDINARY LEVEL EXAMINATION, COMPUTER SCIENCE, 0595, Paper number 3, juin 2025, deux heures et demie. Chaque version a trois tâches : Task I (traitement de texte, 20 points), Task II (tableur, 20 points) et Task III (programme C ou Pascal, 10 points). Transcrites en douze fichiers : numero_exercice G1-T1 à G4-T3 ; groupes ["GROUP 1"] à ["GROUP 4"] ; regles_choix vide : le sujet dit « Do all the tasks » ; le candidat ne passe qu'un seul groupe (non exprimable) et, à la Task III, choisit le programme C ou le programme Pascal (non exprimable non plus).
Les filigranes gcerevision.com / Kawlo, les cadres d'en-tête (numéro de centre, nom du candidat, cadre « For examiners' use only »), les lignes à compléter et les artefacts du scanner sont ignorés.

Aucun logiciel (traitement de texte, tableur) n'a été exécuté : les menus et les étapes sont donnés de mémoire, sous une forme générale, sans citer de version de logiciel, et ne sont pas testés. Les formules de tableur ont été traduites en Python et calculées sur les données du sujet ; les résultats annoncés dans les corrigés en sont recopiés.
Aucun corrigé officiel n'existe : les réponses sont rédigées. Les « marking ideas » sont des répartitions indicatives faites d'après les points imprimés ; le barème du jury n'est pas connu.
Les fichiers de travail du jour (documents, classeurs, images) ne figurent pas dans le PDF : les corrigés donnent la démarche exacte et n'inventent aucune valeur de ces fichiers.

Task 1 : la maquette « Figure 1 » (page 19 du PDF) est une photocopie de très basse résolution, avec des fragments de filigrane qui traversent le tableau et le titre : le filtre de niveaux la rend illisible et laisse des traces. Elle est donc REDESSINÉE (matplotlib, fichier G4-T1_fig_1.png) d'après le scan : mêmes blocs, mêmes textes, même ordre ; la photo de l'ordinateur portable est remplacée par un dessin schématique (une photo n'est pas redessinable fidèlement) et la police décorative du titre par une police à empattements.

Valeurs de la figure lues avec un doute sur le scan flou : « Intel Core i7 8th Gen » (6th ou 8th), « 1,8 GHz » (« Clook Speed » imprimé pour Clock Speed), « 8 GB RAM », « Intel UHD Graphics 620 », « 1920 x 1080 pixels » (1050 possible), « Storage: 500 GB HDD » (600 possible). Les lectures retenues sont celles d'un ordinateur portable i7 de 8e génération (UHD 620, 13,3 pouces Full HD) et d'un i5-4570 de 4e génération ; elles ne changent pas la réponse aux questions mais le tableau de la question 5b les reprend. Le numéro de téléphone de l'ovale est celui du texte de la question 6 (677777777/67222222) ; celui de la figure n'est pas lisible.

Points imprimés : 1 + 1 + 2 + (1 + 1 + 2 + 2) + 2 + (1 + 4) + 3 + 1 = 21, alors que l'en-tête dit 20 : le sujet est conservé tel quel (le « (2 marks) » de la question 5 s'ajoute aux 1 et 4 de ses deux parties 5a et 5b). Les étapes 8 (watermark), 9 (Save) et 10 (Print) n'ont pas de points.

questions.enonce_markdown: Set paper size to A4; Left, Right, top and bottom margins to Narrow (1.27 cm).  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
*Layout* (or *Page Layout*) > **Size** > **A4**; then *Layout* > **Margins** > **Narrow**. The *Narrow* preset sets the four margins (top, bottom, left and right) to **1.27 cm**, as asked.

*Marking idea (1 mark):* A4 paper and the Narrow margins together.

questions.enonce_markdown: Insert a page border with full line style, and width 6 points.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
*Design* (or *Page Layout*) > **Page Borders**. In the *Borders and Shading* box choose the setting **Box**, a **solid (full) line** in *Style*, and **6 pt** in *Width*, apply to *Whole document*, then *OK*. A thick rectangle frames the page, as in Figure 1.

*Marking idea (1 mark):* box border with a full line of 6 pt.

questions.enonce_markdown: Key in the title: ADVERT. Set font to Arial Black or any other sans serif font, size 28, center align and underline.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Type **ADVERT** on the first line. Select it and apply: font **Arial Black** (or another sans serif font such as Arial or Calibri), *Font Size* **28**, **Center** (Ctrl+E) and **Underline** (Ctrl+U).

*Marking idea (2 marks):* sans serif font and size 28 (1); centred and underlined (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
Implement the section below the title as follows:

a. Insert a table with 2 rows and 2 columns.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Press *Enter* after the title. *Insert* > **Table** and drag over a grid of **2 columns by 2 rows** (or *Insert Table* and type 2 for columns and 2 for rows). The table has four cells.

*Marking idea (1 mark):* a table of 2 rows and 2 columns.

questions.enonce_markdown: b. Merge the cells in the first row and key in the information: IT SHOP SERVICES  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Select the two cells of the **first row**, right-click > **Merge Cells** (or *Layout* > *Merge Cells*), then type **IT SHOP SERVICES** in the merged cell. In Figure 1 the text is small, bold and centred on a grey band.

*Marking idea (1 mark):* first row merged and the text keyed.

questions.enonce_markdown: c. In Row 2 Column 1, insert the image of the computer given in your candidate folder and set the height and width to 6.9 cm respectively.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Click in the cell of **row 2, column 1**. *Insert* > **Pictures** > *This Device* and choose the image of the computer in the candidate folder. Select the picture, then in *Picture Format* > *Size* (or right-click > *Size and Position*) untick *Lock aspect ratio* if needed and type **6.9 cm** for the *Height* and **6.9 cm** for the *Width*.

*Marking idea (2 marks):* picture inserted in the right cell (1); height and width both 6.9 cm (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: d. In Row 2 Column 2, type: COMPUTER SUPPLY SERVICES. Set font type to Algerian or any other decorative font, size 48, font color to Green.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Click in the cell of **row 2, column 2** and type **COMPUTER SUPPLY SERVICES**. Select the text and set: font **Algerian** (or another decorative font), *Font Size* **48**, *Font Color* **Green** (*Home* > *Font Color* > Green).

*Marking idea (2 marks):* text keyed in the right cell (1); decorative font, size 48 and green colour (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: Implement the next section of the flyer as shown in Figure 1.  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Click below the table and build the section in two steps (questions 5a and 5b): a sentence of promotion followed by the table of prices and discounts, in the same order as in Figure 1. The marks of this heading reward the placement and the layout of the section as in Figure 1 (sentence under the first table, then the second table, both inside the page border).

*Marking idea (2 marks):* the section follows the order and layout of Figure 1.

questions.enonce_markdown: a. In a new line, key in the information: **We are currently on promotion, with discounts as indicated in the table below.**  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Place the cursor after the first table and press *Enter* to start a new line. Type **We are currently on promotion, with discounts as indicated in the table below.** and make it **bold** (Ctrl+B), as in Figure 1.

*Marking idea (1 mark):* the sentence keyed exactly, in a new line.

questions.enonce_markdown: b. Insert a table and key in the table information shown in Figure 1.  *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
*Insert* > **Table** with **4 columns** and **3 rows** (a heading row and two rows of data), then key in the information of Figure 1:

| ITEM | SPECIFICATIONS | Unit Cost /FCFA | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Laptop Computers | Intel Core i7 8th Gen; Quad Core, 1.8 GHz Clock Speed; 8 GB RAM; 512 GB Hard Disk; Intel UHD Graphics 620; 13.3 inches, 1920 x 1080 pixels; Windows 10 OS; 3 Year Warranty | 700 000 | 10% |
| Desktop Computers | Operating system: Windows 10 Pro 64-Bit Edition; Memory: 4 GB; Storage: 500 GB HDD; Processor: Intel Core i5-4570; Processor Family: 4th Generation Intel Core i5 processor | 500 000 | 15% |

In the figure each specification is a bullet on its own line of the cell (type one specification per line, select them and click *Bullets*) and each item name starts with an arrow symbol; the column headings are in bold and the unit costs and discounts are centred.

*Marking idea (4 marks):* table with 4 columns and the heading row (1); the laptop row (1); the desktop row (1); bullets and bold headings as in Figure 1 (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
Insert an oval shape and type the following contact information:

Call us now

677777777/67222222

Visit our shop at SOMEWHERE STREET, BP 12

Email: itshop@mail.com  *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
*Insert* > **Shapes** > **Oval** (under *Basic Shapes*) and drag it at the bottom of the flyer, wide enough for four lines. Right-click the oval > **Add Text** and type the four lines of contact information, pressing *Enter* between them:

```
Call us now
677777777/67222222
Visit our shop at SOMEWHERE STREET, BP 12
Email: itshop@mail.com
```

Centre the text in the oval and make it bold, as in Figure 1.

*Marking idea (3 marks):* oval inserted (1); the four lines keyed exactly (1); text placed and centred inside the oval (1).

questions.enonce_markdown: Format the oval shape with the Colored Fill, White Outline-Accent 1 Text box Style.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Select the oval, open the **Shape Format** tab (*Drawing Tools*) and in the **Shape Styles** gallery click the style named **Colored Fill, White Outline - Accent 1** (hover over the thumbnails to read the names). The oval gets the coloured fill of accent 1 and a white outline.

*Marking idea (1 mark):* the named style applied to the oval.

questions.enonce_markdown: Insert a watermark and customize the text to the name of the company: **ITSHOP**
questions.corrige_markdown: *Design* (or *Page Layout*) > **Watermark** > **Custom Watermark** > **Text watermark**; type **ITSHOP** in the *Text* box and click *OK*. The name ITSHOP appears faintly behind the flyer. No mark is printed for this step.
Use *File* > **Save As** (or *Save*) and give the file the name **Task 1**, in the working (candidate) folder. No mark is printed for this step, but a file that is not saved cannot be marked.
Use *File* > **Print** (Ctrl+P), check the preview (the page border, the table, the oval and the watermark must be visible), choose the printer and click *Print*. No mark is printed for this step.
